email_text: URGENT: Your bank account has been suspended due to suspicious activity. Verify your account immediately by clicking here: http://secure-bank-verify.example.com or it will be permanently closed within 24 hours.
Dear customer, we detected an unauthorized login to your PayPal account. Confirm your details now to avoid limitation of your account. Click here to restore access.
Congratulations! You have been selected to receive a $1,000 Walmart gift card. Claim your prize now by entering your personal information at the link below. Offer expires today!
Your package could not be delivered. A small customs fee of $2.99 is required. Pay now to reschedule delivery: www.track-parcel-fee.example.com. Failure to pay will result in return to sender.
Hello, this is the IT Help Desk. Your email password will expire in 2 hours. Update your password immediately using this link to keep your mailbox active.

I am Barrister James Okoro, attorney to the late Mr. Henry Collins. He left $8.5 million in an account with no next of kin. I need your help to transfer the funds. You will receive 30% of the total. Reply with your full name and bank details.
Your Netflix membership has been put on hold because of a billing problem. Update your payment information now to continue watching. Click here to update.
ALERT: Your Apple ID has been locked for security reasons. Verify your identity within 24 hours or your account will be deleted. Sign in here to unlock.
Final notice: you owe the IRS $2,340 in unpaid taxes. A warrant will be issued unless you pay immediately using gift cards. Call us right now to avoid arrest.
Dear employee, please review the attached payroll update and log in with your corporate credentials to confirm your new salary details. This must be done today.
Good day, I am a prince seeking a trustworthy partner to move funds out of my country. I will pay you a large commission. Please send your bank account number and passport copy.
Your Amazon order #8841-22 of $899.99 has been placed. If you did not authorize this purchase, click here immediately to cancel and verify your account information.
We noticed unusual sign-in activity on your Microsoft account. Your account will be suspended unless you confirm your details within 12 hours. Click the link to verify now.
Make $5,000 a week working from home! No experience needed. Send us your social security number and bank details to start receiving payments today.
Dear valued customer, your credit card has been temporarily blocked. To reactivate it, update your information and confirm your PIN at the secure link below. Act now!
Your mailbox is almost full and incoming messages will be rejected. Click here to upgrade your storage and verify your account immediately.
Hi, it's your boss. I'm in a meeting and need you to buy 5 gift cards for a client right away. Send me the codes by email as soon as possible. This is urgent and confidential.
You have received a secure document via DocuShare. Sign in with your email password to view the file. The link will expire in 24 hours.
Claim your free iPhone 15 now! You are our lucky winner. Just pay shipping and handling of $4.95 and enter your credit card number here. Hurry, only 3 left!
Security notice: your cryptocurrency wallet requires verification. Enter your recovery phrase at the link below within 6 hours to avoid permanent loss of funds.
Hi Sarah, thanks for sending over the draft. I reviewed it this morning and left a few comments in the shared document. Can we talk tomorrow at 10 to go over them? Best, Mark
Your order #55123 has shipped. It is expected to arrive on Thursday. You can track your package from the Orders page in your account. Thank you for shopping with us.
Reminder: the team meeting is scheduled for Monday at 2:00 PM in conference room B. Please bring your weekly status updates. Agenda attached.
Hello, this is a confirmation of your dentist appointment on March 14 at 9:30 AM. If you need to reschedule, please call our office during business hours.
Dear students, the final exam schedule has been posted on the university portal. Please check your course pages for room assignments. Good luck with your preparation.
Thanks for signing up for our newsletter. This month we cover three new features in our app, a tutorial on shortcuts, and an interview with our design team.
Hi team, the quarterly report is now available in the shared folder. Please review sections 2 and 4 before Friday and send any corrections to Laura.
We received your request to reset your password. If you made this request, use the code 482913 in the app. If you did not, you can ignore this message.
Your monthly account statement is ready. You can view it by signing in to the official app. We will never ask for your password by email.
Hey, are we still on for lunch on Saturday? I was thinking the Italian place near the park. Let me know what time works for you. See you soon!
Thank you for your payment of $45.00 received on April 2. A receipt is attached for your records. Contact support if you have any questions about this invoice.
Hi all, the office will be closed next Monday for the public holiday. Regular hours resume on Tuesday. Enjoy the long weekend!
Your flight to Lisbon on June 5 has been confirmed. Check-in opens 24 hours before departure. Your booking reference is XQ7T2L. Have a pleasant trip.
Dear Dr. Almeida, I am writing to ask whether you would be available to supervise my thesis on machine learning for text classification. I have attached my proposal.
The library has the book you requested on hold. Please pick it up at the front desk within 7 days. Thank you.
Hi Tom, here is the summary of yesterday's call: we agreed on the new timeline, the budget stays the same, and the prototype is due on the 20th. Let me know if I missed anything.
Welcome to the neighborhood association! The next meeting is on the 12th at the community center. Light refreshments will be served. We look forward to meeting you.
Your subscription renews on May 1 for $9.99. You can manage or cancel your subscription anytime from your account settings. Thanks for being a member.
Congratulations on your new job! The whole team is excited to have you with us. Your first day is Monday at 9 AM. HR will meet you at reception with your badge.
Hi Anna, attached are the photos from the weekend trip. The mountain ones turned out great. Send me yours when you have a chance. Talk soon!
